name: Magic Bento
description: Responsive bento grid of interactive cards with cursor spotlight, border glow, optional stars, tilt, magnetism and click ripple. Ships six animated product visuals and accepts custom content or images.
contents: Grid of cards, each with optional icon, label, visual, title and description
Six built-in animated visuals: analytics chart, dashboard bars, collaboration doc, automation steps, integration hub, security settings
Optional background image with scrim per card
Cards render as links, buttons or plain blocks depending on href and click handlers
behavior: Spotlight and border glow follow the pointer across the whole grid
Optional star particles on a canvas inside the hovered card
Optional 3D tilt and magnetic pull on the hovered card
Press scale and ripple wave on click
Staggered intro animation when scrolled into view
Built-in visuals replay their animations on hover and click
Column count drops to 2 or 1 automatically when cells get too narrow
Animations are disabled for prefers-reduced-motion users
Description text auto-hides until hover when textAutoHide is on

props.name: items
props.default: 6 sample items (Analytics, Dashboard, Collaboration, Automation, Integration, Security)

editableByProps: Cards, their text, icons, images, links, built-in visual choice or custom content, and column/row spans
Column count, row height, gap and corner radius
Dark or light theme and glow color
Toggle spotlight, border glow, stars, tilt, magnetism, click effect, intro and all animation

needsCodeEdit.where: VISUALS map and the Visual components above it

needsCodeEdit.change: Change minimum card width before columns collapse

fixed: Needs Tailwind CSS for its utility classes
Injects its own style tag with keyframes
Listens to window pointer, scroll and resize events and document pointerout while mounted
Built-in visuals are string keys, not configurable by props
Column count collapses to 2 or 1 on narrow containers, so it works on small screens
Pointer effects (spotlight, tilt, magnetism, stars) need a hover-capable pointer
Respects prefers-reduced-motion and cannot override it

options.look: Dark card surfaces with light ink and glow
options.useWhen: The page has a dark background

options.look: Light card surfaces with dark ink and glow
options.useWhen: The page has a light background
